interpretation: National/protected status alone is not treated as statutory official status. Language recognition does not demonstrate translation quality or regional variety coverage.

Tamazight is statutory official across its territorial varieties. Kabyle is not the entire Amazigh language grouping. French’s practical use is not denied by removal of an unsupported statutory label.
